skill.summary: Provide new contributors and agents with a concise tour of the workspace identity files (SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md) plus onboarding tips. Use when a newcomer needs context or when you want to double-check how this workspace is configured.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added a detailed "CLI usage" section describing how to use the script with various flags.
- Included practical command examples to clarify real-world use of the CLI.
- Expanded documentation of available CLI options, including `--files`, `--lines`, `--brief`, and `--workspace`.
- Improved onboarding guidance to help users efficiently summarize workspace identity files and configuration.
